verdict_reason: Code-keyed rule accessors are correct and all reachable; one parameter name (id) does not say it holds a type id.

todos.issue: typeTextForId(code, id): the parameter id holds a commodity type id (the '16'/'24'/'2' values typeIdFor returns on line 18), but the bare name id says nothing about which id. The house rule names this exact case (id for an address id). The line was rewritten by this PR (parameter list changed from (name, id) to (code, id)).
todos.fix: Must: the parameter is named for what it holds, a commodity type id. One way: typeTextForId = (code, typeId) => typesFor(code).find((type) => type.id === typeId)?.text.
